greeting.text: State your business. I haven't got time for idle talk.

responses.text: What's the situation with the goblins?
What should I know about the forest?
I took care of the goblin chieftain.

goblin_report.text: Three raids this month. Two caravans lost. My men are spread thin. If you can fight, I need you on the line.

responses.text: What do you know about their leader?

raid_locations.text: East road and the farmsteads south of Thornwood. They hit at night, fast and organized. Unusual for goblins.

organized_goblins.text: Scouts, flanking maneuvers, coordinated retreats. Someone trained them. That worries me more than the raids.

chieftain_intel.text: Chieftain called Skarnak. My scouts tracked his warband to ruins north of Thornwood. Haven't come back since.

missing_scouts.text: Two of my best. Five days overdue. I fear the worst but can't spare anyone to search. Not with the raids.

responses.text: I'll keep an eye out for them.

scout_names.text: Bren and Marta. Good soldiers. If you find them, alive or otherwise, I need to know. Their families deserve that.

scouts_noted.text: Appreciated. Check the old ruins if you're brave enough. That's where the trail went cold.

responses.text: Any bounties I can take on now?

bounties.text: I post bounties on the board weekly. Current priorities: goblin patrols, supply escort, and forest beast culling.

bounty_board.text: Pick what suits you. Complete the job, bring proof, collect your coin. No excuses, no extensions.

best_bounty.text: Beast culling. Thornwood's crawling with corrupted wildlife. Dangerous, but forty coin per kill proof.

corrupted_beasts.text: Bigger than normal. Aggressive. Eyes gone black. The alchemist says it's some kind of Aether taint. I just want them dead.

aether_mention.text: Ask the elf. I deal in steel, not sorcery. My job is protecting this town. Yours is helping me do it.

responses.text: Fair enough. I'll take some bounties.

forest_warning.text: Stay off the main paths in Thornwood after dark. We've lost people. The forest isn't safe anymore.

responses.text: What's in the forest besides goblins?

forest_dangers.text: Wolves, bears, things without names. And lately, the dead don't stay buried near the old barrows. Talk to Aldwin.

responses.text: The dead? What do you mean?

undead_rumor.text: Patrols found empty graves near the eastern barrows. Tracks leading into the forest. I don't like it one bit.

responses.text: You've got bigger problems than goblins.

holt_burden.text: Tell me something I don't know. I've got sixty guards for a hundred problems. So get out there and be one less.

chieftain_bounty.text: You want to take on Skarnak? Rowan vouches for you, so I'll authorize it. Five hundred coin, dead or alive.

chieftain_done.text: Skarnak is dead? Show me proof. ...By the gods, you actually did it. Hearthholm owes you a debt, adventurer.

responses.text: Any new threats I should know about?

post_chieftain.text: The goblins will scatter without a leader. But something drove them here in the first place. Stay sharp.

responses.text: I'll get to the bottom of it.

end_respect.text: You've got my respect. That's not easy to earn. Hearthholm's lucky to have you. Now get back out there.

end.text: Stay sharp. Report anything unusual. Dismissed.
